description: A freshness block computed via freshness-go (current tree digest vs digests stamped on recorded runs in coverage/runs.index.json) showing per-phase fresh/stale/unknown and a copy-pastable suggested refresh command; never-tested scenarios degrade to "unknown", not fake-fresh.

requirements.description: Every score response must include a freshness block computed by packages/freshness-go. The freshness block must compare the current tree digest of the scenario with the digests stamped on recorded runs in coverage/runs.index.json. Each tracked phase must report one of three verdicts: fresh (current digest matches stamped digest), stale (digest mismatch), or unknown (no recorded run exists for that phase). Scenarios with no test history must degrade to 'unknown', never to a fake 'fresh' verdict. The block must include a copy-pastable suggested refresh command listing the stale/unknown phases. No local reimplementation of freshness logic is permitted — only packages/freshness-go must be used.
requirements.title: Freshness Block with Per-Phase Fresh/Stale/Unknown Verdicts and Refresh Command
